test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 6th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The average weight of 14 persons is 76.5 kg. If 3 more persons of weight 82 kg, 75 kg and x kg join them, then the average weight of all the persons increases by 0.5 kg. What is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net increase in total weight = Total persons × Increase in average = 17 × 0.5 = 8.5 kg

Sum of weights of 3 new persons = (3 × 76.5) + 8.5 = 229.5 + 8.5 = 238 kg

Given weights are 82 kg, 75 kg, and x kg ⇒ 82 + 75 + x = 238

⇒ 157 + x = 238 ⇒ x = 81

**∴ The correct answer is 81 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of 14 persons = 76.5 kg

Number of new persons = 3

Increase in average weight = 0.5 kg

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 
 
 

 
 
 
 14 persons (Avg: 76.5 kg)
 
 3 join
 
• 
 
 17 persons (New Avg: 77.0 kg)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of 14 persons = 14 × 76.5 = 1071 kg

⇒ Total number of persons after 3 join = 14 + 3 = 17 persons

⇒ New average weight = 76.5 + 0.5 = 77 kg

⇒ Total weight of 17 persons = 17 × 77 = 1309 kg

⇒ Sum of weights of the 3 new persons = 1309 − 1071 = 238 kg

⇒ 82 + 75 + x = 238

⇒ 157 + x = 238

⇒ x = 238 − 157 = 81

**∴ The correct answer is 81 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the combined average is (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Net Deviation Method

The sum of deviations of all individual values from their average is always zero. Adding new items increases the overall average only if their combined value exceeds the original average.

Average of a Group

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.
